column3: Direct reversal: the same phrase diagnoses inherited communal error.

Retrospective confession shows the accusation can return upon its speakers.
Parallel elite accusation escalates from folly to suspicion of lying.
Nuh rejects the charge and grounds his direction in divine commission.
Uses the phrase as a reasoned self-diagnosis, not an elite accusation.
Ibrahim applies the same diagnosis to a father and collective idolatry.

Shows the phrase used as a social verdict outside prophetic conflict.
